cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I spent Saturday fixing your fence. I taught you to estimate a job; tell me what went into this one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good start, for a beginner. Eighteen screws, two trips to the shop and a blister. Count the day, too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll recommend you next door. They need six panels done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then use the full estimate I just taught you. Tell them three took my entire Saturday before you give away my Sunday as a free sample.
